result.title: Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound Images with Conformal Uncertainty Estimation
result.summary: Thyroid nodules affect a large proportion of the general population. Although most are benign, a non-negligible fraction is malignant. Ultrasound imaging is the primary diagnostic modality, and accurate nodule segmentation is a prerequisite for CAD systems to classify malignancy and assess metastatic risk.\\ In this work, we propose a thyroid nodule segmentation framework that integrates a DeepLabV3+, channel-attention modules and post-hoc conformal prediction, providing both accurate mask and pixel-level uncertainty estimates. We address thyroid ultrasound nodule segmentation as the first stage of a pipeline that also includes malignancy classification and metastatic risk prediction. We adopt DeepLabV3+, whose Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) captures multi-scale context, with an EfficientNet-B5 backbone for its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, we test three channel-attention modules: Squeeze-and-Excitation, CBAM and Grouped Channel Attention (GCA), paired with two loss formulations (Dice-BCE and Boundary).\\ Since binary masks do not indicate prediction confidence, we wrap the trained model with a split conformal prediction layer that produces pixel-level uncertainty maps with statistical coverage guarantees.\\ We evaluate all configurations on the TN3K public benchmark using a fixed split and directly compare them with state-of-the-art methods. The plain backbone already improves upon previously reported results, with CBAM + Dice-BCE emerging as the best overall configuration.

AI.brief_summary: 提出甲状腺超声结节分割框架：以 DeepLabV3+（EfficientNet-B5 骨干、ASPP）为基础，比较三种通道注意力模块与两种损失，并叠加 split conformal prediction 输出像素级不确定性图，在 TN3K 基准上对比现有方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR/VLM 推理主线无直接关联，但其中的 post-hoc conformal prediction 提供带覆盖保证的不确定性量化，可能可供核查作为 latent 推理状态的置信校准或「停不下来还是停止取证」类决策判据。
